evidence: All five dimension prompts (plus the injected app_context.md and every criterion text that is concatenated into them) describe HireOps only; no residue found. Instance-by-instance reconciliation against the frozen seed/brief: (1) URL/deliverable: each prompt.md line 1 'Open http://localhost:3000' and app_context.md:4 match instruction.md:53 (port 3000, one process serving UI+API); the only URLs anywhere in prompts/app_context/judge.toml are http://localhost:3000 (Colderwater lesson 13 satisfied). (2) Credentials: app_context.md:8-19 lists the ten accounts and password 'Hireops!2026' exactly as seed users USR-REC1..USR-CAN3 and instruction.md:57 (names, emails, roles all match). (3) Screens: app_context.md:23-25 'Board ... (stages Applied, Screen, Interview, Offer, Hired, Rejected), Conversations ... and Activity' and candidate applications view match instruction.md:49 and hireops_rules.md sections 3/4/6/7; visual/prompt.md:14 surveys Board, card details, Conversations, Activity and Noor's candidate view; visual 'No phone layout or theme switching' matches instruction.md:49. (4) Entities and seeded facts quoted in prompts/criteria all verified in seed_data.json: three jobs (app_context.md:29) = JOB-PLAT/JOB-DATA/JOB-DSGN; 'Noor Haddad's Platform Engineer conversation is long (120 messages at the start)' = 120 APP-101 messages; gate 'seeded Data Analyst job ... Applied' exists (APP-203 APPLIED); functional/prompt.md:21 'seeded Product Designer job ... Yuki Tanaka (its manager)' = JOB-DSGN manager_id USR-MGR3; hro_intake_restart Platform Engineer Applied 'Greta Lindqvist, Ade Bello, Marco Rossi' and Screen 'Priya Nair, Samuel Ortiz' = APP-105/106/108 and APP-103/104 positions; Noor's card note 'Strong systems answers; weaker on incident follow-up.' = notes[0] on APP-101; hro_candidate 'Platform Engineer (Infrastructure, Interviewing)', 'Product Designer (Design, Application received)', 'Data Analyst (Finance Systems, In review)' = APP-101 INTERVIEW, APP-302 APPLIED, APP-201 SCREEN with candidate_status_labels; hro_unread_seen 'the starting read markers give her 1' = APP-301 has 3 messages, Lena read_count 2, third sent by USR-REC3; hro_long_thread '30 at a time' = thread_page_size 30; hro_messaging fallback (Data Analyst manager Bill, Ingrid not manager) = JOB-DATA manager_id USR-MGR2; interview places 0/51/2.5 refused = rules section 2 'whole number from 1 to 50'; 403/404/401 role answers = rules section 1. (5) Cross-references inside prompts resolve to real criterion ids: hro_unread_seen, hro_intake_restart, hro_two_people (functional/prompt.md:21,25), hro_long_thread and hro_pol_session_resume (polish judge.toml) all exist; restart_app matches tests/tools/restart_mcp.py TOOL name. (6) No template residue: grep finds no CHANGE_ME, TODO, other product names (Colderwater, editor/caret, ledger, ticket, etc.), other ports or account lists; the template's CHANGE_ME app_context was fully replaced and test.sh:198-200 substitutes it into every prompt. (7) Consistency across prompts: the global-gate paragraph (Rafael, Data Analyst Applied, Aud Halvorsen observer in an independent context) is identical in functional/polish/visual and agrees with the constraints gate criterion; Lena-protection rules agree (render 'do not open any conversation', polish:24 'Never use Lena Fischer's conversation', functional:21 exception only for hro_unread_seen). Colderwater lesson 8 (modifier-key hold) is present in app_context.md:33-35 and applies to HireOps multi-select; lesson 10 size: largest assembled prompt (functional prompt.md + app_context + all criteria) about 38.5 KB, under 128 KB. Adversarial check: a conforming app with different labels/routes ('Pipeline' instead of 'Board', 'Inbox' instead of 'Conversations') is protected by 'Discover routes and controls by intent, not assumed names' (each prompt line 1) and app_context.md:37-38; no prompt names a reference-implementation route, selector or field. A broken app cannot exploit any prompt inaccuracy because no misdescribed entity or credential was found. Minor non-defect: functional/prompt.md:1 says 'No shell' twice (redundant wording, not residue). Input hash a79edbb8... matches manifest.json; not independently recomputed.
